scope: Source and fixture corrections following owner feedback; compilation only, without a new runtime/listening or automated test run.
sourceFindings: Archive URIs encode source and entry path in query parameters; the old empty URI path suffix check aliased distinct entries.
Skipping intentionally invalid ZIP entries could therefore mark other rows unreadable and clear their durations.
Archive-relative playlist resolution changed the URI path while retaining the old entry query parameter.
Queue discovery retained unreadable state but dropped other known metadata; gapless promotion omitted the decoded duration fallback.
corrections: Compare archive entry path, deleted-view state and source identity; reject empty ordinary path aliases.
Resolve relative playlist references using ArchiveUri.build and inspect the entry filename for playlist type.
Retain known metadata across queue refresh and metadata merges; propagate actual successful timing to duplicate references and gapless promotion.
Use native archive slices for metadata when available, with existing explicit staging for unsupported sources.
Inspect CDDA byte counts, the supported stereo DSD64 DFF layout, and raw MLP/TrueHD access units without decoding PCM.
Share the existing 2500 ms SoundFont audition policy with metadata.
Give fallback metadata inspection its own bounded read budget.
Parse optional appended NSF time/fade chunks and apply them to both metadata and PCM endpoints.
handsetAcceptance: Pending playlist timing/retention in the reported ZIP, the listed standalone formats and the updated NSF fixture.
limits: Truly untimed NSF still uses the explicit 150-second plus eight-second fade policy; no length is invented from its filename.
Appended metadata parsing does not implement additional NSF2 CPU/IRQ features.
MLP/TrueHD header inspection is bounded; unsupported/interleaved or changing-rate streams can remain unknown.
DSDIFF timing matches the current portable stereo DSD64 conversion policy.
